test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends are standing in a line facing north. Kamayani is at one of the ends. Aanchal is to the immediate left of Preeti. Sakshi is to the immediate right of Kamayani. Shivani is between Preeti and Lakshika. Who is standing between Preeti and Sakshi?
solution:
1) Kamayani is at one end.

2) Sakshi is to immediate right of Kamayani so, Kamayani is at left

end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aaab60273849d9672296b32c287046cbe752249f5f177bfe680123ab672e3a2.png] 

3) Anchal is immediate left to Preeti.

4) Shivani is between Preeti and Lakshika. So, Lakshika is at right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/798c2cd3979e0f85f32fab8f05bea2ea752b3cd44890efbf344cbe28d1174e4a.png] 

Hence, Anchal is sitting between Preeti and Sakshi.
